steps.content: The fight is over. The two of them seem mentally stable. You're relieved.

options: You didn't have to risk your lives to come

steps.content: This is my own decision. No one knows how you guys will be affected if you follow me, I don't want you to take any more risks.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Cut the crap!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahem... These monsters don't scare me. It's not like I've never seen one before.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Just don't freak out like you did just now anymore. If you do that again, I'll... I'll knock you out and drag you back. If even that doesn't work, I'll run away on my own.
If something like that happens again, don't hesitate. Run, or kill me. This way, the shackles won't threaten you anymore.
Protect yourselves, and get your freedom. This is an order.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You...!
She's obviously holding her breath, but she can't get any words out for a long while. Eventually, she gives you a fierce glare and runs off to sulk on the side.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Do you really have to go?
You look at Hecate. Her face is full of an expression you've never seen before. In the end, she can't seem to say what she means to say.

options: Are you trying to stop me too?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'll... follow Chief's orders.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: I'll pass. My protective measures are expiring soon, and I don't want your shackles. It's dangerous.
Accepting the shackles now is no different than tying a huge bomb to himself. You won't impose that on him.
I owe you a favor. When everything's over, I'll repay you.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: Oh, give me a break. I can't wait to be away from you jinxes.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: I thought you were the responsible grown man who watches over those two little freaks, but you turned out to be the craziest one.
steps.female_content: I thought you were the responsible grown woman who watches over those two little freaks, but you turned out to be the craziest one.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: Don't forget to pay when you get out. Wire the money to this account.
Whitestone Industries... You take the business card and see him look up at the sky with a concerning face.
Around the top of the statue, blade-like white lights flash by from time to time, triggering a deafening roar every time. That's "Zoya"... The Ring Master's voice.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: If I come along, I'll only become a burden to that one... You must win.
You nod and bid farewell to the young man. You step inside the statue.
